headline: Crude Oil Prices Gain on Supply Fears Following Houthi Attack on Riyadh
summary: Crude oil benchmarks rose following Houthi attacks on Riyadh that sparked supply disruption fears, though oil remains on track for a third straight weekly loss.
why: Middle East military conflicts frequently impact crude oil shipping lanes and regional energy supply expectations.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Oil futures gained due to immediate supply disruption risks caused by military strikes in Saudi Arabia.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Crude futures rose as Houthi strikes on Riyadh increased risk premiums surrounding Middle Eastern energy exports.
